Claim: PM loop · 2026-11-21T17:40Z · area b1-CX (epic #34571; taken from the mailbox, record 7066493162, the maintainer's 「通知派发」).
Area: b1-CX
Session: `session_01L6bhgXNXwc6aap2K3v32WF` (card thread)
Account: `os-sales`
Branch: claude/project-thread-54ujof
Seat: `repo:objectstack#1`
Domain: `domain:ui`
File surface: app-shell `layout/appTileColors.ts` (one resolver: logo image, then the declared primary colour, then a colour from the app's name), `layout/AppMark.tsx`, `console/home/HomeAppsStrip.tsx` and `launcherTile.ts` (the home tile takes the same branch; the 10-gradient table goes), the `tile-grid` page block, the ⌘K "switch app" rows; tests; changeset.
Container & model: `M`, card thread, `model: opus`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: no (expected: no export or prop change; re-measured on built declarations before push)
Metadata-protocol: none
Premise (thread, read on main `146b6f9b`, file `build-seat1/36157/premise-read.md` in the project folder): holds. Twelve places draw an app icon; recents and search results have no app rows, so nothing to do there. Item 6 holds: the button colour comes only from declared branding, and the automatic colour never enters it (pinned by a test). One correction to the card: `#7C3AED` is HotCRM's expense app; the sales app declares orange `#EA580C`, so its orange buttons are right.
Basis: card #36157; epic #34571; the maintainer's 「同意」 to the three points on the card.
Scope, the seat's reading: palette `OBJECT_COLORS` without `gray` (8 colours), drawn with the exported `OBJECT_COLOR_TILE_CLASS` (white glyph; dark-theme contrast already pinned by #35985). The hash is the repo's `simpleHash` (signed djb2 plus `Math.abs`) modulo 8, copied exactly and pinned name-to-colour by a test. Apps with a logo or a declared colour do not change (all HotCRM apps and every repo app with a colour); the blank template app and AI-built apps get a colour. The `tile-grid` page block and the ⌘K switch-app rows take the same tile (item 1: one icon everywhere). The avatar menu's hidden-apps list and the unmounted `AppCard` are left alone. This card does not extend to objects: #36141 item 4 is with the maintainer.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: no file overlap with #36141 (PR #36164). #36112 moves the app name into the sidebar and writes a new desktop app menu; both must use `AppMark`. Whoever lands second merges main. `overlap-check.mjs` before each push. No declaration L2 while Clause-② stays no; L1 at L1-b. The PR carries `Fixes #36157`.
